run_visualize_surface_3d: run the visualize_surface_3d function to render 3D point clouds from touch sensor image sequences
create_ImageSequenceDataset: create an ImageSequenceDataset to load touch image sequences from a dataset path
create_Visualizer3DViewParams: create Visualizer3DViewParams to define a custom 3D camera view with fov, lookat, and zoom
create_Visualizer3D: create a Visualizer3D instance to render 3D point clouds with custom view parameters
run_Surface3D_point_cloud_3d: run Surface3D point_cloud_3d to generate 3D points, depth, and normals from a color image
